meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page, terminal, and paginated-document surfaces. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift, PDF page check, deck review, blank or near-empty page, wrong page break.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页、终端和文档的视觉效果,标出异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完页面都担心显示效果
copy.tagline_en: Verify UI visuals on web, terminal, and documents via screenshot diffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change UI often and worry about visual regressions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在你构建或修改界面后自动做视觉质量检查：对网页、终端界面和分页文档截图取证，用脚本比对差异，让两个只读审查员分别检查设计系统与视觉保真度，最后给出合格或不合格的结论。
howto.when: 在构建或修改任何界面之后，或当你询问页面、组件或终端界面看起来是否正确时触发；也可用“视觉检查”“截图对比”“界面不对”等说法唤起。

say.text: 我刚改完页面，帮我做一轮视觉检查。
say.note: 会截图并按设计规范逐项审查后给结论。

say.text: 对照这张参考图，看实现还原得准不准。
say.note: 需先提供参考图，会同尺寸截图比对。

say.text: 检查这个PDF的页面排版有没有问题。
say.note: 会逐页渲染成图片来做审查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs visual QA on UI you build or change: captures screenshots/TUI evidence, diffs against references, runs design-system and visual-fidelity reviewer passes, then gives a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after building or changing any UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right; also when you say things like 'visual check', 'screenshot diff', or 'UI looks wrong'.

say_en.text: I just changed the page—run a visual QA pass.
say_en.note: It screenshots and checks against design specs.

say_en.text: Compare this reference image to the implementation.
say_en.note: Provide the reference path for a same-size diff.

say_en.text: Check this PDF's page layout for issues.
say_en.note: Renders every page to an image for review.
